Covariance of a panqr fit

Source: R/panqr.R
vcov.panqr.Rd

Covariance of a panqr fit

Usage

# S3 method for class 'panqr'
vcov(object, tau = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

a "panqr" fit

tau

NULL or one of the fitted quantiles

...

unused

Value

the covariance matrix of the coefficients at quantile tau; when several quantiles were fitted and tau is NULL, a list of matrices, one per quantile

See also

Other panqr methods: plot.panqr(), summary.panqr()

Examples

set.seed(2)
d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:100, each = 5), t = rep(1:5, 100))
d$x <- rnorm(500) + rep(rnorm(100), each = 5)
d$y <- d$x + rep(rnorm(100), each = 5) + (1 + 0.2 * abs(d$x)) * rnorm(500)
fit <- panqr(y ~ x, data = d, index = c("id", "t"), tau = c(0.25, 0.75),
             model = "mmqr")
vcov(fit, tau = 0.75)
#>             x
#> x 0.003527145
